title: Pan-Seared Prawns with Kanom Sauce
description: A Thai-inspired dish featuring succulent prawns cooked to perfection and served with a sweet and tangy kanom sauce.
instructions: Rinse the prawns and pat them dry with paper towels.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add the tiger prawns.
Cook for 2-3 minutes per side or until the prawns are pink and cooked through.
Remove the prawns from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the thai curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes or until fragrant.
Add the kanom sauce and stir to combine.
Return the prawns to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the prawns hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
Serve with steamed rice or noodles for a complete meal.
